_about.purpose: Library manifest for the kinetic-typography lyrics library. Lists every track available to the Kinetic Typography page so it can populate its track picker and load lyric text on demand.

schema.tracks: array of entries; one per library track
schema.tracks[].id: stable slug; matches this entry to its sibling <filename>.json
schema.tracks[].title: display title shown in the track picker
schema.tracks[].file: sibling filename holding the full lyric document
schema.tracks[].hasLrc: true when a real LRC file exists; the JSON carries NO per-line timestamps either way
schema.tracks[].bpm: optional; absent for tracks that were never analysed
schema.tracks[].durationSec: optional; used to spread lines evenly as ESTIMATED timing
schema.tracks[].source: which generator produced the track (e.g. 'Suno v6-mini')

_about.timing_warning: Entries carry no word-level timestamps. The loader distributes lines evenly across durationSec as placeholder timing for PREVIEW ONLY - never for final renders. A real LRC or word-timing pass supersedes the estimate.
_about.extending: To add a track: create <filename>.json with {id,title,hasLrc,lyricsStatus,sections:[{name,lines[]}]}, then add a matching entry here. Keep ids and filenames in sync.
